jobs.description:
RESPONSIBILITIES:

Planning Management:

• Process and monitor information related to incoming goods received via email; manage the inbound mailbox.
• Schedule truck deliveries via email and telephone.
• Enter all announced shipments into planning files/Excel.
• Prepare and monitor mid- to long-term planning and forecasts (FCST).
• Maintain oversight of delivery schedules, slot bookings, and warehouse capacity utilization.
• Proactively solve problems and provide recommendations to Planning, Operations, Carriers, and Transport Management.
 

Receiving Operations:

• Create ASNs (Advance Shipping Notices) and Inbound Deliveries.
• Enter Purchase Orders (POs) into SAP, manage the Delivery Due List, and create inbound deliveries.
• Verify shipment labels and ensure control over the origin of goods and batches.
• Maintain, update, and analyze master data.
• Communicate with customs brokers regarding import and export customs clearance procedures.
• Initiate packaging adjustments to optimize logistics processes.
 

Continuous Improvement:

• Continuously assess opportunities for process improvement.
• Contribute ideas to optimize inbound goods flows, including transportation, booking slots, and packaging.
• Prepare reports on KPIs, carrier performance, packaging usage, and related metrics.
• Coordinate with carriers and suppliers when KPI targets are not achieved.
 

Driver Reception Desk:

• Serve as the primary point of contact for truck drivers; assign gates and manage check-in/check-out through the slot booking system.
• Process, create, and manage CMRs, packing lists, invoices, and export documentation for both incoming and outgoing AM/OE shipments.
• Provide drivers with all required documentation.
• Perform administrative tasks.
• Print locator labels and tickets.
• Resolve operational issues and exceptions.
 

Outbound (Backup Support):

• Create deliveries based on Excel files, emails, or SAP follow-up activities.
• Determine picking priorities based on collection schedules while considering warehouse picking capacity.
• Release and coordinate transportation for ICY shipments within and outside Europe.
• Release and monitor transportation activities for the French market.
• Arrange and track transportation for DACH, Nordic, Benelux, and other markets.
• Resolve issues related to transportation, goods, and materials.
• Act as the communication link between Customer Service, Operations, and Carriers.
• Analyze and follow up on transportation claims in C4C.

• Knowledge of warehouse processes, inbound operations, and picking techniques
• Good command of Dutch and English, both written and spoken.
• Strong analytical skills.
• Proficiency in SAP, Microsoft Office, and slot booking systems.
• Able to work independently, in a structured manner, and under pressure.
• Strong communication skills.
• Customer-oriented mindset.
• Continuous improvement mentality.
• Team player.
• Strong focus on safety and compliance with regulations.
• Preferred: Experience in spare parts inventory management.

In this dynamic role, you will be a key player in our marketing efforts, focusing on both content creation and campaign execution for the Benelux market.

Content & Localization

• 
Translate & Localize: You will deliver high-quality translations from English to Dutch and French for a wide range of marketing materials, including websites, social media, newsletters, and videos, skillfully adapting the content to resonate with the Benelux market.

• 
Ensure Brand Consistency: Act as a brand guardian by meticulously reviewing and proofreading all texts to ensure they are consistent, accurate, and perfectly aligned with our brand voice.

• 
Create Engaging Content: Support the creation of compelling marketing content that highlights the innovation and value of Bosch parts, equipment, and services.

Marketing & Campaign Support

•

•

You are currently a student pursuing a degree in Marketing, Communication, Business, Translation, or Language Studies, with a clear passion for content creation and marketing communications.

You are highly proficient with the MS Office Suite (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams). Experience with creative tools like Adobe InDesign or Premiere Pro is a significant advantage.

• 
As a well-organized and detail-oriented multitasker, you thrive in a fast-paced environment and can work independently to meet tight deadlines.

• 
You are an excellent communicator and a collaborative team player who enjoys achieving goals together.

• 
Language Skills:

• 
Dutch: Native or equivalent proficiency (Mandatory)

• 
English: Full professional fluency (Mandatory)

• 
French: A good working knowledge is a strong asset.

Are you a skilled welder with an eye for detail and a passion for metalworking? Then we have a great opportunity for you!

Jobomschrijving

As a welder, you will be responsible for accurately assembling and welding a variety of metal constructions based on technical drawings and specifications. You play an important role in delivering high-quality end products and actively contribute to maintaining craftsmanship and reliability. You will work closely with your colleagues to ensure projects are completed efficiently and within set deadlines. In addition, you act as a representative of the organization in contacts with clients and partners.

·        Experience in welding, preferably semi-automatic (TIG is a strong plus)·        Accuracy and a strong focus on quality·        Flexibility and the ability to work under pressure·        Team spirit and a positive work attitude·        A professional and presentable appearance·        Proficiency in Dutch or English·        Willingness to learn and further develop your skills

Our client is a key organization within the services sector, known for its strong expertise and continuous focus on innovation and service excellence.

Jobomschrijving

As part of a dynamic and growing organization, you'll take the lead in designing and executing a comprehensive rewards strategy aimed at attracting and retaining top talent, while also ensuring employee satisfaction and engagement across multiple entities.

Key Responsibilities

- In collaboration with external partners and internal HR teams, you'll ensure the seamless execution of payroll processes and employee administrative functions, maintaining accuracy and compliance with relevant laws.
- You'll be responsible for developing and deploying a robust total rewards framework that aligns with organizational goals and attracts, motivates, and retains talent.
- Manage the administration of competitive compensation and benefits programs, ensuring they are aligned with local market practices and legal requirements.
- Guide and support a dedicated HR team, fostering growth and aligning efforts to departmental and organizational objectives.
- Prepare and present regular updates, optimizing current reporting practices to enhance efficiency and quality. You will also be involved in streamlining reporting tools and methods.
- Ensure HR policies are consistently updated and in line with legal standards, providing legal expertise on employment-related matters.

The ideal candidate can demonstrate the following skills and experience:

- You hold a Bachelor's or Master's degree in a relevant field, or bring equivalent experience.
- You bring 10+ years of experience in Payroll and Compensation & Benefits, combining both strategic insight and hands-on expertise.
- You have a solid track record in people management, with the ability to lead, coach and develop high-performing teams.
- You possess an in-depth knowledge of Belgian social legislation and Total Rewards frameworks.
- You are fluent in French, Dutch, and English, enabling you to operate effectively in a complex, multilingual environment.
- You are an excellent communicator and presenter, comfortable engaging with a wide range of stakeholders, including C-level executives, employee representatives, and internal teams.
- You thrive in complex and highly regulated environments, navigating challenges with structure, rigor, and adaptability.

jobs.occupation: Sr. Accountant position w/ strategic impact - Zaventem - Legal
jobs.description:
Our client is an international firm that provides legal services across different sectors. They are currently looking for a senior accountant that can work autonomously to support the finance manager.

Jobomschrijving

In this role you will be handling the A-Z accounting tasks, including the following:

• General accounting tasks
• Performing monthly, quarterly, and year-end closings
• Review and control of the balance sheet
• Preparation and filing of the annual accounts (NBB)
• Submission of periodic VAT returns
• Preparation of corporate income tax
• Point of contact for audit matters
• Monthly financial reporting
• Process optimization and automation

We are looking for someone that matches the following criteria:

• Bachelor's degree in Accounting
• Minimum of 5 years experience in general accounting
• Strong knowledge of BE GAAP
• Fluent in Dutch and/or French, good command in English
• Excellent command of Excel
• Analytical mindset
• Team player with good communication skills

This role is a HR Officer Learning & Development position focused on coordinating training, performance management, and job structuring processes while ensuring strong adoption of HR tools across the organization.
It is ideal for a dynamic and structured profile who enjoys working with people, coordinating trainings, and driving change in a digital HR environment. 

Client Details

Our client is an international company combining a corporate, international culture with a strong focus on efficiency, quality, and innovation. They support business operations through technology-driven solutions and continuous improvement of internal processes.

The environment is collaborative and evolving, offering employees the opportunity to grow and develop within the company. The company is located in Diegem at the border with Brussels and is easily accessible with public transport.

Description

As L&D HR Officer, you'll be responsible for:

• Coordinate, organize, and deliver training sessions
• Maintain & update the training catalogue
• Identify development needs and manage relationships with external training providers
• Ensure accurate HR data management and documentation (training records, performance data, job files)
• Coordinate and manage the performance management cycle (ensuring timely completion of objectives setting and reviews)
• Act as key user of HR tools providing user support and driving adoption across the organization
• Maintain and update job descriptions, job grading, and organizational charts
• Support career development initiatives
• Contribute and support HR activities when needed

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in HR, training, education, or a related field
• Fluent in English, with a good command of French and Dutch
• First experience in HR, HR Development, Learning & Development, or a similar role (junior profiles welcome)
• Dynamic, proactive, and able to convince stakeholders to adopt new tools and processes
• Strong organizational skills with a structured and detail-oriented mindset
• Curious and hands-on, with a willingness to learn and take ownership of HR systems and tools
• Strong communication skills with the ability to interact at all levels of the organization

jobs.occupation: Bus Mechanic – good salary + training opportunies
jobs.description:
Do you enjoy working on vehicles and solving technical problems? In this role as a bus mechanic, you ensure that coaches are safe, reliable and ready for daily operations.

• You carry out maintenance and repairs on buses.

• You diagnose mechanical issues and fix them efficiently.

• You perform preventive maintenance to keep vehicles in top condition.

• You work on a varied fleet of different brands and models.

• You ensure every vehicle meets safety and quality standards.

• You have a background in mechanics (experience is a strong plus).

• You can work independently and take responsibility for your tasks.

• You are able to identify and solve technical problems.

• You are eager to learn and interested in new vehicle technologies (like electricity).

• You are open to following additional training.

• You speak Dutch or English.

• You are flexible with working hours while valuing a good work-life balance.

• A driving license D is a plus.

Our client, a biotech company based in Zwijnaarde, is a global biotechnology firm bringing innovative CAR-T cell therapy to Ghent. Through this work, they make a daily difference in the lives of many patients suffering from cancer and other life-threatening diseases.

They are currently in a phase of significant growth and are looking for motivated and dedicated team members.

Jobomschrijving

Do you have experience working in a warehouse or in logistics in general? Then we are looking for you!

In this role, you’ll be part of a supportive and collaborative team within an international pharmaceutical production company.

As a Warehouse Associate you'll manage the following:
	
• You take care of everything that comes in and goes out of the company and ensure that every step is properly documented.	
• You handle inventory receipts and transactions related to inbound, picking, and outbound operations.  	
• You receive and inspect biological products in a temperature-controlled environment, ensuring all GMP/GDP procedures are followed.  	
• You safely handle all materials and ensure they are stored correctly.  	
• You perform inventory checks to maintain stock accuracy and support order picking and packing activities.

	
• 	
You have experience in logistics or warehouse work.
		
• 	
You are looking for a long- term job, and you are enthousiastic to learn new skills. 
		
• 	
You pay attention to detail and like to work accurately.
		
• 	
You follow procedures carefully to ensure product quality and your own safety.
		
• 	
You enjoy working in a team and support your colleagues.
		
• 	
You communicate well in English.
		
• 	
You can travel to work with your own transportation method.
		
• 	
You are comfortable using a computer and Microsoft Office.

The company is an international player in the chemical industry, focused on producing basic raw materials derived from oil and gas. These materials are used by other companies to manufacture products such as packaging, plastic components, industrial applications, and consumer goods.

Operating on a global scale, the organization combines manufacturing, logistics, and international trade within a highly integrated business model. The work environment is strongly process-driven, with a focus on quality, supply chain excellence, and customer satisfaction.

In addition, the company places a strong emphasis on innovation and sustainability, investing in more efficient production processes and the development of increasingly recyclable materials.

Jobomschrijving

Job Description

In this role, you will play a central part in processing and managing customer orders within an international environment. You will ensure smooth administrative handling while monitoring quality, timelines, and communication throughout the entire order lifecycle.

Key Responsibilities
	
• Coordinate and manage the complete order process from request to delivery	
• Process sales orders and quotations with a strong focus on accuracy	
• Liaise with internal departments regarding product availability, deliveries, and invoicing	
• Prepare and manage export documentation for international shipments	
• Handle returns and follow up on customer complaints	
• Keep customers informed about order status and deliveries through reporting tools	
• Maintain proactive communication with stakeholders, including customers, Sales, Supply Chain, and Finance teams	
• Prepare and distribute reports on order status, deliveries, and critical issues	
• Identify potential bottlenecks within processes and contribute to improvement initiatives	
• Participate in internal meetings and collaborate with various departments

Requirements
	
• Bachelor's degree or equivalent through experience	
• 1 to 3 years of experience in customer service, administration, or order management	
• Experience in an international environment is a strong asset	
• Experience in the shipping industry	
• Experience with shipping documents (Sea Waybill, Bill of Lading,...)	
• Good knowledge of Microsoft Office applications (Excel, Teams, Power BI)	
• Knowledge of Incoterms and international payment terms is considered an advantage	
• Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously	
• Highly detail-oriented with a strong focus on quality and accuracy	
• Proactive and solution-oriented mindset	
• Customer-focused with excellent communication skills	
• Team player who thrives in an open and collaborative working environment	
• Able to work independently with a hands-on approach	
• Fluent in English, both written and spoken. Knowledge of Italian, Spanish, or any other additional language is a plus.

jobs.occupation: Customer Support Advisor: English + German + 1 other European Language
jobs.description:
For our client we're looking for a Customer Service Officer.
In this role, you become the voice of support for drivers facing unexpected vehicle issues across Europe. You'll be part of a fast-paced and multilingual contact center where your communication skills, empathy, and sense of urgency play a crucial role in keeping transport moving.

- Handle incoming assistance requests from international customers experiencing roadside vehicle breakdowns.
- Take ownership of each case by coordinating with local service providers and technicians until the issue is resolved.
- Maintain constant communication with both the customer and service partner, providing regular updates and reassurance.
- Think on your feet and apply a proactive approach to problem-solving, often finding creative solutions under time pressure.
- Be an integral part of a tight-knit, multilingual team that thrives on collaboration and mutual support.
- Operate within a 24/7 environment, where teamwork and flexibility are essential to ensuring seamless customer experiences.

- You speak and write fluently in English, German and at least one other European language.
- You are service-driven and naturally inclined to go the extra mile to support customers in stressful situations.
- Strong interpersonal skills help you adapt your communication style to various cultural and professional contexts.
- You enjoy working in a diverse team setting and are always ready to help others succeed.
- Flexibility to work in a rotating shift schedule, including nights and weekends.
- A hands-on mentality with a structured and solution-oriented mindset.
- Eagerness to continuously develop your skills and embrace new challenges.

Our client is a group of specialised companies, together employing around 200 people.
Each company within the group has its own expertise: production of components, welding works, coating, concrete constructions and assembly.

You will join a professional and stable work environment with a highly modern machine park and a strong focus on quality.

Your tasks:
 
• TIG welding of steel and stainless steel constructions 
• Working in a modern workshop with advanced machinery 
• Choice between: 
  
• Pure inhouse-based work 
• inhouse work combined with occasional on-site installation  
• Attractive day shift: 7:30 AM – 4:15 PM (one hour earlier finish on Fridays)

Our client, a well-established company in the food production industry located in Zottegem, is looking for a motivated and experienced Technical Operator.

Hoe ziet jouw takenpakket eruit?
As a Technical Operator, you play a crucial role in the production process.

You ensure that the production lines run efficiently and intervene quickly whenever deviations occur. Thanks to your technical insight, accuracy, and problem-solving skills, production continues smoothly.

Your responsibilities:
 
• Setting up, operating, and monitoring production lines. 
• Performing quality checks and making adjustments where necessary. 
• Detecting technical malfunctions and independently resolving minor defects. 
• Carrying out machine changeovers, cleaning your equipment, and ensuring machines function correctly. 
• Recording production data and strictly following established procedures. 
• Assisting with preventive maintenance and actively contributing ideas for process improvements. 
• Maintaining a safe, clean, and organized work environment at all times.
Working hours are from Sunday evening to Friday morning in a fixed night shift from 10:00 PM to 6:00 AM.
 
• You have previous experience as a Technical Operator. 
• You have a strong technical interest and are eager to learn. 
• You are willing to work in a fixed night shift. 
• You have a good command of Dutch and/or English. 
• You work accurately, responsibly, and have a strong focus on quality. 
• You can independently analyze and solve technical issues. 
• You are a team player and communicate effectively with colleagues. 
• You perform well under pressure in a fast-paced production environment. 
• You have a hands-on mentality and enjoy taking initiative. 
• You have your own transportation or can easily commute to the workplace during night hours. 
• You live within a 20 km radius of Zottegem.

For a family-run company in the tyre sector, we are looking for an experienced tyre fitter to join the branch in Destelbergen.

Our client works for cars, trucks, agriculture and industry, and runs several branches across Belgium.

Hoe ziet jouw takenpakket eruit?
 
• You fit, repair and balance tyres. Plenty of trucks and agricultural vehicles, so proper work with heavy equipment. 
• You work cleanly and safely. A wheel that is not perfectly secured is never an option. 
• You step in wherever you are needed. In a small team, everyone pitches in. 
• After six months to a year, once you know the job inside out, you also join roadside call-outs. The employer pays for the training and your category C licence.
 
• Experience as a tyre fitter. By far the most important point on this list. 
• A category B driving licence. 
• Dutch or English is enough. If French is your main language, we do need a basic level of English on top of it so you can work smoothly with the team. No need to be fluent. 
• Someone who is punctual, gets stuck in and takes safety seriously. 
• The ambition to build something long term with one employer.

jobs.occupation: Weekend Production Operator – Flexible Schedule, Attractive Pay, and Career Growth
jobs.description:
Are you looking for a rewarding and well-paid temporary opportunity to gain hands-on experience in a modern production environment? As a Weekend Production Operator, you will play a key role in ensuring smooth and efficient operations for a well-respected company in Kaulille. This temporary role runs from July through September and is ideal for individuals who are available and motivated to work long weekend shifts.

Your typical day involves operating and monitoring state-of-the-art machines, conducting quality checks, and maintaining strict hygiene and safety standards. You'll rotate between day and night shifts: one week you'll work from 6:00 AM to 6:00 PM, and the following week from 6:00 PM to 6:00 AM. You will also be responsible for cleaning equipment, applying HACCP procedures, and stepping in wherever needed on the production floor to support your team.

If you enjoy working in a fast-paced, collaborative environment and you're looking to boost your income over the summer, this is the role for you. Apply now to join a team where your reliability and technical insight are valued, and where there’s potential for a long-term position based on your performance!

• Commitment to work weekends for the full 3-month period (July–September)
• Availability for both day (6:00 AM–6:00 PM) and night (6:00 PM–6:00 AM) shifts on a rotating basis
• Good command of English or Dutch
• Technical insight or an affinity for technical work
• Ability to work accurately, hygienically, and safely
• Suitable for candidates not in full-time weekday employment

Are you ready to take charge on a production line? Do you enjoy working with your hands and being part of a close team?

Join one of the world’s leading mushroom companies, right here in your region. As an operator, you’ll help keep the line running — adjusting machines, switching molds, and sealing mushroom boxes. You work 5 days a week, with either the full weekend off or a weekday off if you work Saturday. Your shift starts at 6am or 8am depending on the season.

What you can expect:

• A key role in a solid, reliable team

• Hands-on work with real responsibility

• A company that’s big in the global mushroom market

• Long-term opportunity for people who want to grow

Sound like your kind of job? Let’s talk!

• You’re someone who keeps an eye on the bigger picture — you think ahead, spot small issues before they become big ones, and help the line run like clockwork.

• Experience in a production environment is a plus, but if you’re motivated and hands-on, we’ll get you up to speed.

• The working language in the company is English, so Dutch is not required.
